title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer regional backoff + load-shedding ordering
author: Maya Thompson
description:
Background: During the 2026-02-18 incident we saw the SLO enforcer thrash between regional backoff states which caused aggressive load-shedding in healthy regions. Root cause: a combination of (1) non-deterministic region ordering when evaluating backoff windows and (2) aggressive immediate-threshold checks that ignored recent smoothing. This PR fixes the ordering and smoothing, adds defensive checks to avoid repeated forward-progress resets, and hardens the canary rollout path.

Summary of changes: - Ensure deterministic region ordering when building the backoff candidate set (sort by region id then priority). - Replace immediate threshold flips with an exponential smoothing window (alpha=0.25 default) to avoid oscillation on short bursts. - Add per-region last-progress timestamps and a minimum-backoff-grace period to avoid immediate re-entry into shedding after short recoveries. - Add metrics and tracing spans for backoff decisions to make debugging/regressions easier. - Add regression unit + integration tests that reproduce the thrash scenario (synthetic multi-region spike followed by rapid recovery). - Add a k8s canary manifest + rollout job to incrementally roll this change with automatic rollback on erroring canary probes.

Why this is urgent: The thrashing caused downstream customer-facing error spikes and client-side retries that increased overall system cost and latency; this is a release-blocker for the Dedicated/Private customers who require stable regional failover behavior.

What I changed (high level): - services/slo-enforcer/backoff.go: deterministic ordering + smoothing + grace logic - services/slo-enforcer/backoff_test.go: new regression + unit tests - services/slo-enforcer/main.go: wire tracing and metrics - observability/metrics/slo_enforcer.metrics.yaml: new metrics and dashboards hooks - deploy/k8s/slo-enforcer-canary.yaml: canary rollout and probes - docs/runbooks/slo-enforcer.md: updated troubleshooting steps and rollback instructions

Testing and validation: Unit tests added and passing locally; integration tests simulate cross-region spikes and validate no thrash within 5-minute window. CI: unit + integration + lint all passed; canary deployed to staging and observed for 30 minutes with no regressions.

Rollout plan: 1) Deploy canary (5% traffic) for 30m, 2) Observe new backoff metrics and tracing spans for regressions, 3) If stable, ramp to 50% and hold 30m, 4) Full rollout. Canary job includes automatic rollback on probe failures.

Fallback and rollback: Reverting to previous hash restores prior behavior; runbook updated with immediate mitigation commands (scale up enforcer pods, temporarily disable regional backoff) for emergency rollback.

Notes: This is a minimal-hit hotfix focusing on stability; follow-up PR will expose smoothing tuning via config and add telemetry-driven auto-tuning (ENG-4210).
